# OSSConnect llms.txt

OSSConnect is an open-source initiative dedicated to building India's next generation of open-source contributors. We create accessible pathways for developers to learn open source, make meaningful contributions, collaborate with global communities, and grow into mentors and maintainers.

## Ecosystem & Partners
We provide exposure to a wide range of organizations, including CNCF, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Meshery, JSON Schema, OpenSSF, NumFOCUS, and many more.

## Purpose & Direction
- **Vision**: Make India one of the world's most trusted, collaborative and impact-driven open-source contributor ecosystems.
- **Mission**: Create accessible pathways for developers to learn open source, make meaningful contributions, collaborate with global communities, and grow into mentors and maintainers.
- **Values**: 
  - Open (Learn openly)
  - Useful (Create value)
  - Respectful (Respect people)
  - Consistent (Keep showing up)

## Community Pipeline
Access -> Contribution -> Mentorship -> Leadership

## Tech Stack (Website)
- Next.js (App Router)
- React
- Tailwind CSS v4
- Framer Motion (Animations)
- Lucide React (Icons)
- Vercel (Hosting)

## Join Us
Reach out to the community via our official WhatsApp channels or join our GitHub organization: https://github.com/OSSConnect.
